bio:
Liz works part-time on reception, where she greets customers, manages appointments and helps keep the salon organised. She enjoys seeing the full grooming journey, from welcoming dogs through the door to the moment they are reunited with their owners after their appointment.

Her rescue dog, Lewi, has become her constant companion and occasionally joins her at work as an enthusiastic canine greeter. Liz brings kindness, reliability and a calm presence to the front of house, helping both customers and their dogs feel comfortable and looked after.
